Find the area of $△ABC.$ Round your answer to two decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
The formula for the area of the triangle is 

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}ab\operatorname{sin}⁡C,
$$

where $∠C$ is between the sides of lengths $a$ and $b.$ 

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}b & =CA=8, \\ a & =CB=10, \\ m∠A & ={43}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since 

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘}=0.681\,998,
$$

rounded to six decimal places,  we calculate the area as follows:
 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 10\cdot 8\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{43}^{∘} \\  & =40\cdot (0.681\,998) \\  & ≈27.28\,{\text{cm}}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to two decimal places.
